request: Build a small inventory management system: Python + Flask + SQLite, HTML/CSS/JS front end, a JSON API, dashboard statistics and stock movement history.
requirements:
data source: SQLite file in the project folder (no server)
entities: products (name, category, quantity, unit_price, reorder_level) and stock_movements (product_id, movement_type, quantity_change, reason)
api: list/create/read/update/delete products, dashboard stats, movement history
metrics: product count, total inventory value, low-stock count, units
charts: KPI cards, a low-stock bar and a category breakdown drawn from the API responses
stack: Flask + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, parameterised SQL only
tests: python unittest covering CRUD and the dashboard totals
scope: local single user, no login
